name: 60468 · Peotone, IL
findings: ZIP 60468 (Peotone) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60468 (Peotone) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60468 (Peotone) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60468 (Peotone) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
